campaign.title: 12VP Welcome 01 — Who We Are
campaign.description:
Klaviyo welcome flow draft. Subject: Welcome to 12 Volt Power
Preview: Professional-grade DC power, not hobby-grade parts.
Timing: Send immediately after consented list signup.
Primary goal: first ecommerce purchase. Keep as draft; do not schedule or send.
campaign.html_content:
Professional-grade DC power, not hobby-grade parts. Here's what to expect from us.

Powering & Connecting the World

Welcome

Good to have you here

Powering & Connecting the World isn't just a line under our logo. It's the reason we exist.
We stock reliable DC power products and system solutions for boats, RVs and vans, off-grid builds, radio setups, work trucks, emergency vehicles, and specialty equipment. That's the whole business—not a side category on a shelf full of unrelated parts.

DC power specialists

One-stop shop for DC power, not a generalist electrical supplier.

Professional-grade only

Victron, Blue Sea, Anderson, Scanstrut, and other brands built for real use, not hobby shelves.

Real technical support

USA-based, and staffed by people who actually know the products.
Over the next two weeks we'll show you what we carry, where to start, why we only stock professional-grade components, and how to get technical help before you order. No filler and no daily noise in your inbox.
See what we carry
Free shipping
on orders over $100 		Same-day ship
on in-stock orders by 1PM PST 		USA support
real technical help
Questions already? Call (800) 962-2611, Mon to Fri, 8AM to 4PM PST.

12 VOLT POWER
